verdict.rationale: Adyen provides APIs to build your own UI for onboarding, balances, and transaction data (docs-6, docs-9, docs-8), and split payments/payouts data can be surfaced in a platform's own UI under its brand, satisfying the core embeddable/white-label ask via API-first approach. However, evidence does not show pre-built embeddable UI components (like white-label widgets) specifically for balances, payouts, or transaction history — only raw APIs plus an Adyen-hosted onboarding page (docs-7), which is not white-labeled inside the platform's own product. Missing for 10: dedicated white-label UI components/SDKs for balance/payout/transaction display, documentation of embeddable widgets, and independent/hands-on confirmation of branding customization depth.
